components.css: .ds-email-primary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 44px; min-width: 198px; min-height: 54px; padding: 12px 19px; color: var(--paper, #f7f4ef); background: var(--ink, #242323); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #242323); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--pink, #f386a1); font-family: var(--font-sans, Manrope), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-email-primary svg { font-size: 23px; } .ds-email-primary:hover { transform: translate(-1px,-1px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--pink, #f386a1); } .ds-email-primary:active { transform: translate(3px,3px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--pink, #f386a1); } .ds-email-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #242323); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-email-primary { transition: none; } .ds-email-primary:hover, .ds-email-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.css: .ds-header-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Manrope), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-header-nav a { color: var(--ink, #242323); padding: 12px 0; text-decoration: none; text-decoration-color: var(--line, #c8c4bd); text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-header-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-header-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #242323); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-header-nav { gap: 28px; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-header-nav { display: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The incumbent identity pairs a warm paper surface with dark ink and a concentrated pink field. Large, tightly set Manrope headings give the content confidence; IBM Plex Mono supplies a quieter technical voice in window chrome, compact labels and the footer.

The interface is open and ruled rather than enclosed in repeated cards. A real particle experiment inside a square retro window provides the playful signature. This document records the implemented visual system; the service-first homepage composition and its local review status live in the surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, ink and a single pink accent family.
Large sans-serif headings with restrained monospaced details.
Fine rules, square controls and deliberate whitespace.
A live Canvas experiment with a local SVG still fallback.

rules.name: The Paper and Ink Rule
rules.body: Keep the content on paper with ink text and thin rules; use pink to punctuate the established identity and interaction.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for content and actions; reserve IBM Plex Mono for compact technical labels, window controls and footer details.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary content flat; retain solid offsets on the established window and primary action.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper, ink, pink and locally served font pairing.
Do use open content, thin rules and clear type hierarchy for service and process information.
Do retain the real Canvas artwork, its pause control and the local SVG fallback.
Do provide visible keyboard focus and readable single-column mobile content.
Do keep the retro window and primary-action offsets specific to those established components.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent palette or local fonts with a generated concept's approximate colors or type.
Don't use generated concept PNGs as substitutes for the live particle artwork.
Don't turn every content group into a raised card or spread window chrome across ordinary prose.
Don't add decorative monospaced labels where the current content hierarchy already works.
Don't make essential information or contact actions depend on animation, hover or Canvas availability.
